rules.title: Activity details
items: The activity is available on the Sealos China site only; accounts registered via API do not join the referral rewards.
Referral rewards apply to newly invited users only: ¥5 for the invitee and ¥5 for the inviter.
The ¥10 Desktop first sign-in reward covers new and existing users who have not claimed it, once per account.
Rewards are cloud credits (gift-code balance), redeemed automatically once conditions are met — no manual application.
The referral is locked in only when the account is first created; existing accounts cannot be bound retroactively.
Inviters are not required to complete real-name verification.
